experiment_data.hypothesis: Spectral-guided adaptive data mixing using log_det signal (tau=0.005, k=1.0, r_min=0.20, r_max=0.80) achieves lower perplexity and higher effective rank than fixed 50/50 mixing, because log_det provides earlier and more sensitive collapse detection than eff_rank (D010: tau=0.02 with eff_rank signal caused controller to never trigger)
